'''Lobis Lobin''' was a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who lived during the waning days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Lobin served the Republic as a [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]].<ref name="WS" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> Lobin was [[Death/Legends|killed]] along with seven other [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] during the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] [[Fall of Falleen|attack]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]].<ref name="WS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lobis Lobin was mentioned in the [[2008]] novel ''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]'' written by [[Karen Miller]].<ref name="WS" />
